Guidance on radio checks at the skyport
The desk wrote this for readers
Companion Animal Travel Desk topic on preparing pet travel at Aurelia Skyways

Traveling with a companion animal can feel smoother when you know what the desk looks for. This guide keeps the steps simple and steady so you can arrive prepared and keep your pet comfortable through the process.

Before you head to the skyport, check that your crate is clean, secure, and easy to carry. <<FACT F068>> Bring the papers the desk asked for, and keep them close so you can show them without delay. If your animal is anxious, give yourself extra breathing room and use a calm voice while you move through the terminal.

At the desk, a welfare coordinator reviews comfort needs and looks for anything that might affect the trip. Share details about feeding, water, toileting, and any stress signs you have noticed. If your pet has a special routine, say so early so the team can guide you toward the next step without confusion. Clear notes help everyone stay focused on the animal's wellbeing.

If something unusual happens during check-in, the incident reporting path should stay simple. <<FACT F102>> Tell the staff what you saw, what changed, and whether your pet needs attention right away. Keep your description plain and complete. That makes it easier for the team to respond in the right order.

When boarding is underway, follow the directions given at the gate and stay near your travel documents. <<FACT F105>> If you feel unsure, ask the nearest staff member to point you to the right contact before you move on. A calm pace and a short list of next actions usually help the day go better.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
